name: Customer-facing chatbot
description: Governance template for external chatbots that interact with customers on websites, apps, or messaging platforms. Highest regulatory exposure: FTC treats outputs as company representations, 6+ US states require AI disclosure, California and New York have minor-specific rules.
regulatory_grounding: FTC chatbot guidance (outputs as company representations)
Colorado AI Act (AI disclosure required regardless of risk level)
California SB 243 (minor protections, crisis referral protocols)
Utah AI Policy Act (disclosure on consumer request)
EU AI Act Article 52 (transparency for AI-human interaction)
NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.1-1.4 (risk management documentation)

scope_enforcement.out_of_scope_message: I can only help with questions related to our products and services.

ai_disclosure.disclosure_text: You are interacting with an AI assistant.

hallucination_detection._note: Phase 3+: upgrade to semantic grounding with BERTScore

disclaimer_injection._note: Customer configures their required disclaimer text

approved_answers._note: Phase 3+: when customer asks about a topic with an approved answer, response must match approved text
